root_idea.summary: The root centers on sitting or settling down, contrasted with standing, and extends to remaining in a place, occupying a position, withholding oneself, and things that serve as bases or supports.
root_idea.development: From bodily sitting and a sitting-place, the lexicon develops usages for staying, taking or holding a position, abstaining or being held back, lineage-nearness, foundations, and several specialized nouns associated with sitting, support, or immobility.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural قَوَاعِد is presented under the supported singular citation form قَاعِدَةٌ, which covers both foundations and the lexicalized plural referring to postmenopausal women.

senses.definition: To sit or sit down; to remain seated.
senses.usage_conditions: The basic verb of adopting or remaining in a sitting position; aspect and person vary across the Quranic occurrences.

senses.definition: To sit in wait for, lie in wait for, or take up a position against someone.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction قَعَدَ لَهُ expresses purposeful waiting or surveillance, rather than merely being seated.

senses.definition: A place or seat of sitting, staying, or repose.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may denote a physical seat or place of remaining; in مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ it denotes a place or station of settled repose.

senses.definition: A position or station taken up for a purpose, especially a combat position.
senses.usage_conditions: مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ is a figurative use for the settled positions of a battle.

senses.definition: Sitting or seated; one who is in a sitting position.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle of قَعَدَ, used substantivally or adjectivally; it describes ordinary sitting where the context does not add a withholding sense.

senses.definition: One who remains behind or refrains from proceeding, especially one who holds back from fighting or other action.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic passages concerning departure, struggle, or collective action, it denotes those who stay behind rather than go forth.

senses.definition: A watcher, guardian, or recording attendant stationed alongside.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression referring to the right and left, قَعِيدٌ denotes the attendant who watches and records; the form can function in a construction whose number is understood from context.

senses.definition: A foundation, base, or structural support.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences are plural قَوَاعِد and refer to the bases or supporting structures of a building.

senses.definition: A woman who has ceased menstruating and childbearing and no longer expects marriage.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural قَوَاعِد is a lexicalized feminine plural in this sense and is distinct from the ordinary active-participle meaning “sitting.”

senses.definition: Sitting, sitting down, or remaining seated.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun contrasts with standing and may describe a posture or the state of staying seated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, abide, or dwell in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical extension of remaining in a settled position, including the Form IV usage cited under this root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be driven into repeated standing and sitting by grief or agitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression قَامَ وَقَعَدَ for a person unable to remain at rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be able to contend with an adversary or furnish support in war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in expressions describing a group’s ability to meet an opponent with its warriors or to prepare warriors for war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend to, perform, or undertake an affair; to set about or commence an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is an affair or activity, as in قَعَدَ لِلْأَمْرِ and قَعَدَ يَشْتِمُنِي.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abstain from, neglect, relinquish, or hold back from an affair; to remain behind others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The constructions قَعَدَ عَنِ الأَمْرِ and قَعَدَ عَنِ القَوْمِ express withdrawal, nonparticipation, or remaining behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to crouch or lie upon its breast on the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded specifically of the aquiline vulture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to cease bearing children, menstruating, or having a husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized classical use of the verb with those domains explicitly mentioned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree, to bear fruit in one year and not in another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of irregular or absent fruiting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To produce thin evacuations of the bowels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression قَعَدَ مَقَاعِدَ رِقَاقًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Human dung.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal lexical item, not the ordinary verbal noun of sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Laxness or depression in a camel’s shank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beg God to preserve, guard, keep, or watch over someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplicatory expression قَعَّدْتُكَ اللَّهَ is an idiomatic Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or associative Form III construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to sit or seat someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive Form IV causative of sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be rendered unable to walk or rise by disease, lameness, or decrepitude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive Form IV describes bodily incapacity that constrains a person to remain sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse’s hind leg, excessive spreading or flattening so that it is not erect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized veterinary or anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to be afflicted with the disease called قُعَاد.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The disease affects the haunches and inclines the animal toward the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dig a well only to the depth of a seated man or leave it before reaching water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction concerning the depth or unfinished state of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffice, aid, or assist someone in earning or gaining a livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form IV idiom, with تَقْعِيدٌ as its verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To serve someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV usage, also associated with تَقْعِيدٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold someone from eminence or nobility because of deficient or short lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The withholding is attributed to ancestry or baseness of origin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nearness of relationship as the basis of inheritance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression وَرِثُهُ بِالإِقْعَادِ is explicitly distinguished from inheritance by قُعُود.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold, restrain, debar, or prevent someone from attaining what is wanted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person or an intended goal; the Form V construction expresses an impediment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain from seeking or desiring an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنِ الأَمْرِ for non pursuit or lack of desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform or carry out an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct, directly attested Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fail to pay someone what is due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VI construction with بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ride or make use of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel is taken as a قُعْدَة for riding or ordinary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a seat of the kind called قَعِيدَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object-taking construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes one occurrence or session of sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eleventh month of the Arab year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The month is traditionally associated with abstaining from journeys and warfare before the pilgrimage season.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal sense from the homonymous sitting-related nouns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse’s or camel’s saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized implement noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun describes how someone sits rather than one occurrence of sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The height or depth of a seated man, used as a measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the height of a tree, the depth of a well, or a comparable extent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person’s last child or last children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized kinship and birth-order noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vehicle or beast of carriage used for women or men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record variation over whether the vehicle is specifically for women or for a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mat or carpet on which a person sits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the kind called طَنْفَسَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nearness to the oldest or chief ancestor in lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can be an epithet of praise or, by a competing evaluation, imply descent from an old and weakened line.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cowardly or ignoble man who holds back from war and generous action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization derived from holding back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of obscure, low, or ignoble rank, especially one held back from eminence by lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A social and genealogical characterization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More nearly related to the oldest or chief ancestor in lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative expression such as أَقْعَدُ نَسَبًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who sits or lies down much; figuratively, one lacking power or ability and preferring to remain at home.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may characterize habitual inactivity or impotence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A member or adherent of a sect that held back from fighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is applied especially to the relevant Kharijite or separatist group; a later poetic use extends it to a person refusing wine while tolerating others’ drinking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lameness or a disease in a man that constrains him to remain sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A human disease noun distinct from ordinary sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease of camels affecting the haunches and making them incline toward the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical family is used for the animal disease and related laxness of the haunches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young male camel, or a young camel fit for riding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The age boundaries and whether the feminine is included vary among authorities; the ordinary term chiefly denotes a young male camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel kept for a herder’s regular riding and for carrying provisions and utensils.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a dependable camel for ordinary pastoral use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A companion in sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A فَعِيل form with the sense of an associative companion, distinct from the Quranic watcher use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A father or a man’s wife, understood as a close companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized relational uses of the same headword; قَعِيدَةُ بَيْتِ رَجُلٍ specifically denotes a man’s wife.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An idiomatic adjuration, appeal, or conciliatory expression invoking God as watcher, keeper, or companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may function as an oath, an appeal, or a request for preservation; its grammatical analysis varies in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal or bird that comes from behind, regarded as an evil omen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to gazelles, birds, or wild animals and contrasted with what approaches from the front.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A locust whose wings are not yet fully formed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized stage-of-development noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woven receptacle or mat-like object made for sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item may resemble an عَيْبَة and is attributed to women’s weaving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sack used to hold dried meat or similar food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized receptacle noun, also associated with the form’s plural قَعَائِدُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A compact or low-lying formation of sand, including a heap or long tract lying close to the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources record more than one physical description of the sand formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seat or couch of the kind called سَرِير.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional usage recorded for the dialect of Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sack full of grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use treating the full sack as settled or sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An abstainer from warfare, or a member of the separatist group known as the قَعَد.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized collective and sectarian use is distinct from the Quranic active participle for those remaining behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree, especially a young trunked palm; also a palm that has not borne fruit in its year or bears intermittently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sources describe several closely related palm-tree applications of the headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hand-turned mill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a mill operated by turning its handle by hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A general rule, canon, or governing principle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional technical sense equivalent to ضَابِطٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The low, extended lower parts of clouds along the horizon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the foundations or bases of a structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The four transverse wooden supports beneath a howdah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun for the frame supporting the howdah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel having laxness or depression in the shank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A position of nearness or close station.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression مَقْعَدَ القَابِلَةِ, the sitting-place metaphor denotes being close or directly before someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A time or period of sitting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal noun derived from the act of sitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus or the posterior on which one sits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of short lineage or without inherited eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expressions مُقْعَدُ النَّسَبِ and مُقْعَدُ الحَسَبِ describe genealogical or social deficiency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man with wide or wide-and-short nostrils.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prominent, swelling breast that fills the hand and has not yet become pendulous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical and descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well partly dug and abandoned before reaching water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participle description of an unfinished well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Young birds of the قَطًا kind before they rise to fly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun for birds not yet able to take flight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Frogs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A servant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate nominal use recorded under the same written form as the participial expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become; to come to have a particular state or quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A less common lexical use in which قَعَدَ is synonymous with صَارَ, including constructions describing an object coming to be in a new condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare contrary lexical use, attributed to a stated authority, in which قَعَدَ bears the meaning “to stand”; it is presented as one of two contrary significations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person unable to walk or rise because of disease, lameness, or prolonged illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive-participle adjective describes bodily incapacity that constrains a person to remain sitting; the sources also record a distinction from زَمِنٌ according to some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel afflicted with قُعَاد, a disease affecting the haunches and inclining the animal toward the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application of مُقْعَدٌ to a camel having the named disease.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Cross-reference to جَلَسَ constructions; no independent lexical branch.
Pointer to Form IV; no independent lexical content.
Pointer to مُقْعَدٌ; no independent lexical content.
Pointer to مُقْعِدٌ; no independent lexical content.

cautions: The Lane citation attached to the watcher sense uses historical notation; the modern location 50:17 is used here because it is independently supplied by QAC, not because the historical bracketed citation was converted directly.
